items.problem: The state of the maintenance and kill switch cache before the first read and after a failed read is not set. Line 233 sets only that job `admin_switch_cache` reads the state again and that the instance that made a change updates its own cache. `skills/server-core/SKILL.md:109` and `skills/server-core/modules/routing.md:71` start listening on the port before `server-time.end_start`, and `skills/server-core/modules/server-time.md:91` runs a job for the first time in `end_start`. So a request can reach `routing` steps 4 and 9 (`skills/server-core/modules/routing.md:111`, `:116`) before the first read has ended. Run path: maintenance is on, a server instance restarts, a request arrives between listening and the end of the first read. One implementation answers `MAINTENANCE` because it loaded the table in `complete_start` or holds the request, and another handles the request because its cache is still empty. `skills/build/SKILL.md:186` starts the new server with maintenance on, and this request can then be handled during that deploy. `skills/server-core/modules/server-time.md:93` says only that a job function logs its own failures, so whether a failed `storage.read_db` keeps the previous cache is also not set.

Two rules name the admin secret differently. Line 32 has no environment condition and says the admin secret is `server.read_secret`(`adminSecret.<operator name>`). Line 277 says `secret` of `adminOperators` is the name of the secret in the host secret store, and `tools/ogw.md:530` sets the `secret` of `ogw` to `admin-ogw-<lowercase environment>`. `skills/server-core/SKILL.md:100` reads key `name` from the host secret store outside the LOCAL server and test servers, and its rule for a name set in game settings covers only `environments.<ENV>.secrets.<key>`. Run path: an STG server that follows line 32 reads `adminSecret.ogw` from the host secret store, gets `null` because `ogw secret generate` and `ogw deploy` store `admin-ogw-stg`, and does not start by line 267. Nothing states that line 32 applies only to the LOCAL server and test servers.
